arm.description: Arm whose wrist RGB-D joins head_camera in scene fusion and whose source-bound ALOHA end-effector compiler is used.

target_ref.description: Current observation-bound target from grounding or segmentation; target-mask points remain tied to its source camera.

max_candidates.description: Maximum candidates returned, 1 to 3, default 3: the front of the IK-ordered pool described under IK selection; it does not select a grasp.

camera.description: Exact current native-resolution RGB-D source: head for central top-down geometry, front for visible frontal appearance, or a wrist when its current pose supplies useful detail.

text.description: Short visible object or part description, never a simulator identifier.

max_candidates.description: Maximum ranked regions to return, 1 to 3, default 3. Three is what the grounding service answers per call, so a larger number is refused before the request is sent rather than returned as an error you cannot act on. Every returned region gets its own close-up preview; nothing caps previews across a step, and no count of images already in the conversation refuses this call. Fewer regions answer faster: three cost roughly 479 milliseconds against 244 for one.
